None of the name variations work. The only executable actions are MOUSE (with row/col, and apparently with a 'button' parameter too) and the directional keys (currently invalid). 'ACTION7' remains a mystery, but it's probably not needed — the game might be solvable with MOUSE alone.
Let me reconsider the game. Key facts:
- Blue ball (9x9, gray core) at top right, (11-19, 44-52).
- Dotted line from the ball toward the lower left at 45°, dots at (19,44),(21,42),...,(51,12),(55,8),(57,6). Wait, let me re-verify the dot positions: from the first segmentation, 20 dots. Let me get the exact positions.
- Purple 3x3 square: originally at (58-60, 3-5); now at (52-54, 9-11) after clicking the plus.
- The white plus was at (52-54, 9-11) — clicking it moved the purple square there.
- Purple 3x3 at top HUD (4-6, 30-32).
- Timer bar at the bottom, decreasing by 2 per action.
Hypothesis A: This is a "billiards" game: the purple square is the cue ball? No...
Hypothesis B: The dotted line is the ball's intended path; the purple square is a "blocker" that can be placed anywhere by clicking; the plus was a "placement preview." Goal: place the square so the ball hits it, and then the ball... changes color? Or the ball is captured?
Hypothesis C: The plus is a "goal" for the square. Clicking the plus moves the square to the goal → but the level isn't cleared.
Hypothesis D: This game is "catch the falling ball": the ball rolls along the line; you need to place the purple square at the end of the line to catch it. The square is currently on the line at (52-54,9-11). The ball will roll and hit the square. But who launches the ball? Maybe the ball is already rolling — but the frame is static (the ball hasn't moved across steps). The ball hasn't moved at all so far.
Wait — maybe the ball moves when the timer bar hits a certain value, or when you click the ball. Right-clicking the ball did nothing. What about left-clicking the ball? I right-clicked (15,48) — the default button might be left, and 'button':'right' might have been ignored. In fact, the first test was {'action':'MOUSE','row':15,'col':48,'button':'right'}, which executed and only changed the bar. So clicking the ball (left or right) does nothing.
Hmm, what about clicking the purple square itself? Or clicking the HUD square? Let me try clicking the purple square at (53,10) — it might be selectable/movable. Or clicking the top HUD square.
Actually, wait. Let me reconsider the plus. In many of these generated grid games (this looks like a procedurally generated "ARC game"), the plus is a "cursor" that indicates where the mouse will place something. The white plus might be the mouse cursor's position! When I clicked (53,10), the cursor was already there. The purple square moved to the cursor's position because... the game moves the square to the cursor on click? But clicking (30,30) didn't move the square. Unless the cursor moved to (30,30) and the square only moves when the cursor is on a "valid" cell (e.g., on the dotted line!).
That's it! The square only moves when the click is on the dotted line (a valid position on the ball's path). (30,30) is not on the line → no move. (53,10) is on the line (the line passes through rows 52-54, columns 9-11) → the square moved there!
And the white plus: initially at (52-54,9-11) — that's on the line. Hmm, but the plus disappeared after the click. Maybe the plus is a "target" marker: the square needs to be placed on the plus. Now the square is on the plus.
So the goal might be: place the square on the plus (done) and then the ball rolls and hits the square → level clear? But the level hasn't cleared. Maybe I need to do something to launch the ball.
Or the plus might be a "goal" for the ball: the ball needs to reach the plus's position. The ball rolls along the line and stops at the purple square (which is currently blocking the path at the plus's position). If the square is at the plus, the ball hits the square at the goal → clear?
Since the ball isn't moving on its own, maybe the ball moves every N steps, or when the timer bar reaches a threshold, or when I click a specific location. Let me observe: has the ball moved at all? Compare the ball's position across all frames: it's been at (11-19,44-52) the whole time. The dots haven't changed either. So nothing is moving on its own.
Maybe the game requires clicking the ball to launch it — I clicked the ball's center (15,48) — nothing happened. Hmm, but maybe I need to click the ball's core (the gray part at (14-16, 47-49))? (15,48) is exactly the core. Nothing happened.
Maybe I need to click the HUD square at the top? Let me try clicking (5,31).
Or maybe the game is: the ball rolls toward the lower left; the purple square is a "wall" that the ball bounces off; the goal is to bounce the ball to the upper left or somewhere. The purple square in the top HUD might be a "goal" that the ball needs to reach.
Let me try clicking the top HUD purple square and see if anything happens (maybe it toggles the ball's launch).
